text: Android tests: closeWhenIdle deadlocks when a registry write is pending on a test-dispatcher database (hung the 3.2.0 release gate)

Fixed in cb9bda2e (before the 3.2.0 tag): flush on Dispatchers.Default while the test dispatcher is pumped; regression test fails within 20 s under the old code; two consecutive full runs of 760 app tests clean, then the release gate green.
